channel.title: Dispatch: Neorgon fleet news
channel.description: Launches, features, and fixes across the Neorgon fleet, approved at the desk before publishing

item.title: Dispatch is live
item.description: The fleet gets a front page. Launches, features, and fixes land here as short stories, each one approved at the desk before it ships.

item.title: Stake deals itself in
item.description: The print-and-play boss rush for one player, one die, and the bricks you own is now a registered fleet site. Rules, printable cards, an on-screen runner, and a balance simulator are on the way to stake.neorgon.com.

item.title: The Header Kit counts arrivals right again
item.description: The shared header's arrival pattern now counts #s= hashes, so deep links into a site register the way plain visits do.

item.title: Pixeldoll joins the fleet
item.description: Build a 16x16 pixel character in the browser, then meet it again in Floorplan: the my-character cookie carries your doll across the fleet.

item.title: Fleet avatars learn to walk
item.description: The Avatar Kit gains three walk frames, and Floorplan's Sim mode uses them to send little people strolling around your team map.

item.title: One tiny pixel person, every site
item.description: The Neorgon Avatar Kit lands: 16x16 characters with tiers, share codes, and a fleet-wide cookie, vendored to sites the same way the header and footer kits are.
